Holmes}} |height=2 [[meter]]s |mass= |hair=[[Color|Brown]] |feathers= |eyes=Blue |skin=Light |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Imperial Army]]In "[[Into the Breach]]," Holmes's [[rank insignia plaque]] shows two [[Color|red]] pips and one blue, which corresponds to the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army]] according to ''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]''. **[[Imperial Officer Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|What division are you with? These uniforms are not regulation.''"
[Hunter remains silent]
"''I asked you a question, trooper.''"
"''Step aside. My division. And my orders are classified. If you have an issue with that, lieutenant, then contact Governor Tarkin.''"
"''Uh, y-yes, sir.|Holmes questions Hunter before being answered by Rampart|audio=Holmes-Rampart-TBB-IntoTheBreach.flac|}} '''Holmes''' was a [[human]] who held the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Army|army]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] and was placed in charge of [[Docking Bay 5-02]] on board [[Imperial Station 003]] above the [[planet]] [[Coruscant]]. During or after [[18 BBY]], the [[Rho-class transport shuttle|''Rho''-class transport shuttle]] designated [[Alpha-44]] was cleared to land in the [[Hangar|docking bay]] but did not appear on Holmes' manifest, and so the lieutenant questioned the [[shuttle]]'s crew—in fact a disguised [[Clone Force 99|group]] of rogue [[Cloning|clones]] infiltrating the [[Space station|station]]—until the group's ally, former Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]], gave him a dressing down. Holmes then left the hangar, but later returned with questions about its base of origin, which he directed to the clone [[Wrecker]]. Agreeing to verify the shuttle's [[signature key]], Wrecker instead knocked Holmes out, dumping the [[Imperial officer]]'s unconscious form back in the hangar when Alpha-44 departed the station. ==Biography== ===Manifest malfunction=== {{Quote|Who is responsible for this vessel? It is not on my docking manifest for today.|Holmes|audio=Holmes-Manifest-TBB-IntoTheBreach.flac|}} [[File:HolmesQuestions-TBB-IntoTheBreach.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=Wearing a gray Imperial uniform, Holmes stands beside the armored clones Hunter, Crosshair, and Echo, with Rampart visible behind them in an Imperial hangar.|Holmes questioned the crew of the shuttle Alpha-44 after it landed in his docking bay.]] Holmes was a [[human]] that served in the [[Imperial Officer Corps|officer corps]] and [[army]] of the [[Galactic Empire]] during its [[Imperial Era|reign]], holding the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[lieutenant]] and working on board [[Imperial Station 003]] in [[orbit]] of the [[planet]]{{EncyclopediaCite|Coruscant}} [[Coruscant]] by some point. During or after [[18 BBY]],{{TBBDate|313}} he oversaw [[Docking Bay 5-02]] on board the [[Space station|station]] when the [[Rho-class transport shuttle|''Rho''-class transport shuttle]] designated [[Alpha-44]] was cleared to land in the [[Hangar|bay]]. As the [[shuttle]] was not on his manifest, Holmes entered the hangar to question the crew and approached the [[Imperial officer|officer]] and three [[Cloning|clones]] that had disembarked. He did not recognize the [[officer]] as the disgraced former Imperial [[Vice Admiral]] [[Edmon Rampart]] or the clones as the rogue [[Clone Force 99]], who had used the [[Thief|stolen]] shuttle to infiltrate the station and discover a route to the secret [[Mount Tantiss]] [[Tantiss Base|Imperial facility]]. After receiving no answer to who was responsible for the shuttle, Holmes cast his [[eye]]s over the clones and questioned what [[division]] they were with, noting that their [[Clone trooper armor|armor]] was not regulation. When the clone [[Hunter]] still did not respond, Holmes pressed him before Rampart stepped forward and identified the clones as part of his division. [[File:HolmesRampart-TBB-IntoTheBreach.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=A worried looking Holmes salutes Rampart.|Lieutenant Holmes received a dressing down from "Captain" Edmon Rampart.]] Rampart, who was disguised as a [[captain]] senior in rank to Holmes,{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-into-the-breach|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Into the Breach"}} then informed him that their mission was classified and told the officer to take it up with [[Governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin]], head of the secretive [[Tarkin Initiative]],''[[Star Wars: Rogue One: The Ultimate Visual Guide]]'' if there was a problem with that. Standing to attention before apologizing and saluting, Holmes quickly claimed there was no issue and left the docking bay when prompted by Rampart. ===Wrecker's ruse=== {{Quote|Where is your captain?''"
"''Uh, captaining.''"
"''Yes, well, there is an inconsistency with this shuttle's base of origin. I will need you to verify your vessel's signature key.''"
"''Um, sure thing, boss. Right this way.|Holmes and Wrecker|audio=Holmes-Wrecker-TBB-IntoTheBreach.flac|}} [[File:WreckerHolmesPunch-TBB-IntoTheBreach.png|thumb|right|300px|alt=An armored Wrecker swings a fist out to strike Holmes in the back of the head as the officer stands inside the ''Rho''-class transport shuttle Alpha-44.|Wrecker knocked out Lieutenant Holmes.]] After discovering an inconsistency with the shuttle's base of origin, Holmes later returned to Docking Bay 5-02 and climbed the [[Entry ramp|ramp]] onto Alpha-44, finding the clone [[Wrecker]] seated inside. Ordering the clone to stand in front of him, Holmes asked for Rampart's location, but when Wrecker's answer proved unhelpful, he asked the clone to verify the shuttle's [[signature key]] instead. Wrecker then directed Holmes to a console, which he used to close the shuttle doors before punching the lieutenant in the head and knocking him out. Wrecker took the Imperial's [[Imperial kepi|cap]] and reported having to subdue Holmes to Hunter, who had moved further into the station with the others. When they returned with a plan to reach Mount Tantiss, Wrecker carried Holmes out of the shuttle and dumped his still unconscious form in the docking bay, returning the [[Clothing|hat]] to Holmes's head before the clones and Rampart departed Imperial Station 003 in the shuttle. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Now, carry on.''"
"''Uh, yes. S-sorry, sir.|Rampart and Holmes|audio=Holmes-Stammering-TBB-IntoTheBreach.flac|}} Holmes was a prime example of the Empire's zest for order, swiftly interrogating any visitors not logged in his manifest. Although the lieutenant stammered and backed down when receiving a dressing down from Rampart, the mere appearance of the supposed captain's authority was not enough to quell Holmes's suspicions about the new arrivals. Holmes stood two [[meter]]s tall and had light skin, [[Color|brown]] [[hair]], and blue eyes. ==Equipment== Holmes wore a gray [[Imperial officer's uniform]] with black [[boot]]s, a black [[belt]] with an [[officer's disk]] on the buckle, and a second disk on his gray Imperial kepi. His [[rank insignia plaque]] showed two red pips and one blue, and he carried a [[datapad]] while working in Docking Bay 5-02. ==Behind the scenes== Holmes was voiced by [[Ben Diskin]] in "[[Into the Breach]]," the thirteenth episode of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[April 17]], [[2024]].{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}} Although the character's name was listed in the episode's credits, it was unclear which Imperial lieutenant in the episode the name applied to until a databank entry for the character was released the [[April 18|following day]]. ==Appearances== {{Indexpage}} {{Mediacat|soundcat=Audio files of Holmes|imagecat=Images of Holmes}} *{{TBB|Into the Breach}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/bad-batch-declassified-into-the-breach|text=''Bad Batch'' Declassified: 5 Highlights from "Into the Breach"}} *{{Databank|lt-holmes|Lt.
